quest.title: Custom Gift Envelope No. 4
quest.description: Someone seems interested in creating a Gift Envelope...

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: #Happy Lantern Rite, {NICKNAME}. I heard about how you helped Dehya with the gift envelope. It was beautiful, thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Everything is settled back at the village, I'm guessing?

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: Yes, it's all thanks to Dehya and the others. I can rest a little easier knowing the village is still protected while I'm gone.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Take this time to get some good rest.

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: I will. Dehya wants to visit Qiaoying Village in a few days.

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: She said the scenery is beautiful, and the village is known for their tea. It's a perfect gift for the people back home.

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: I was planning to follow the tradition here and make a few gift envelopes for them.

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: But, Dehya packed our schedule to the brim, and with all the running around, I'm not sure I'll have the time...

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: Dehya told me you're good at making gift envelopes. Could you show me how to make one?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Of course, just leave it to me.

talks.objective: Complete the Gift Envelope with Candace

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: #So, that's how it's done... This gift envelope is wonderful, {NICKNAME}, thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: Now, I just need to make a few more to give alongside the souvenirs I bought. I'm sure the people back home will love them.

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: But, this one... I'm keeping just for me.

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: Dehya told me you're good at making gift envelopes. Could you show me how to make one?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Of course, just leave it to me.
